desc: Verify impossibility invariants rigorously and finalize the Yes/No criterion: No iff (R odd) or (R==0 and B odd); check against all samples and small edge cases.

Design and write down explicit constructions with exact coordinate formulas: (1) B=0, R even: 2×(R/2) perimeter ring; (2) R=0, B even: rotated ring in (u,v) coordinates with u∈{2,4}; (3) mixed case R even ≥2, B≥1: red ring rows 2–3 cols 1..p with the (2,p)→(3,p) edge replaced by a blue chain.

Apply the one-line fix in the R==0 branch (use u∈{2,4} instead of u∈{0,2} so r≥1), then hand-simulate the mixed-case blue chain for B=1,2,3,4 and run a randomized checker plus brute-force existence check for small (R,B).

Finalize the Python solution: mixed branch handles B==1 and B==2 as dedicated cases (avoiding the m=0 down-left collision with red (3,p)), fast I/O in place, and all branches (B=0, R=0, B=1, B=2, odd B≥3, even B≥4) hand-simulated and verified end-to-end.
